chunks: The Lord of Moses and Aaron.
ai.seo_question: Who are Moses and Aaron referred to as servants of in this Quranic phrase?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the monotheistic continuity between Musa and Harun, highlighting their role as divinely appointed leaders who maintained the unity of Tawhid amidst the Israelites' struggles. It reflects the scholarly view that their shared lordship signifies not only their prophetic status but also their submission to the singular authority of Allah, reinforcing the concept of divine servitude (Ubudiyyah) central to Shia theology.
